text:
In a sunny green forest, there lived a super-fast brown Hare who loved to brag. Every single day he would zoom past the other animals shouting, "I am the FASTEST creature alive! No one can beat me!"

The other animals grew tired of his boasting.

One morning, Hare spotted old Tortoise shuffling slowly along the path. Hare burst out laughing. "Ha ha ha! You're so SLOW! A snail could lap you twice!"

Tortoise looked up calmly with a kind smile. "Would you care for a race, then?"

News spread through the entire forest! The big race was set for Saturday morning. Every animal gathered along the route.

Fox held the starting flag high. The finish line was the great oak tree on the far hill. "Ready… Set… GO!" Fox waved the flag!

ZOOM! Hare shot ahead like a rocket! In the blink of an eye, he was halfway to the finish. He glanced back and Tortoise was just a tiny dot far behind.

"HA! This is too easy!" laughed Hare, doing flips on the path. "I have all the time in the world!"

"I'll take a little nap," yawned Hare, flopping down under a shady apple tree. "I'll still win with PLENTY of time to spare."

Soon he was snoring loudly. Zzzzzzz… The warm sun and buzzing bees made him sleep deeper and deeper.

Meanwhile, Tortoise kept walking. Step… step… step. He didn't rush. He didn't rest. He just kept going, one steady foot after another, breathing slowly and smiling.

"Slow and steady," Tortoise whispered to himself. "Slow and steady wins the race."

When Hare finally opened his eyes, the sun was low in the sky! Birds were chirping the evening song. "Oh NO!" he gasped, leaping to his feet.

Hare sprinted faster than he had ever run before — faster than the wind! But it was too late…

Tortoise crossed the finish line to a HUGE roar from all the animals! Confetti flew everywhere! Tortoise beamed with joy.

Hare arrived seconds later, panting hard. "But… but… I'm FASTER than you!" he gasped.

"You are," smiled Tortoise kindly. "But I never stopped. Never give up!"

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: Slow and steady wins the race!
